entries.title: LightProbe is deprecated and no longer lights anything
entries.todo: Use scene.environment, or a LightProbeGrid (LightProbeGridWebGL with WebGLRenderer) sized to cover the area it should light. LightProbeGenerator and LightProbeHelper do nothing any more.

entries.title: AmbientLight and HemisphereLight add specular reflections to PBR materials
entries.todo: Metals no longer render black without an environment map and rough surfaces get brighter at grazing angles. With scene.environment set too, the fill now reflects: lower its intensity.

entries.title: Multi-bounce ambient occlusion weakens AO on bright and metallic surfaces
entries.todo: Increase the strength of screen-space AO (GTAONode scale, SSAONode intensity), or re-bake or darken the aoMap. Keep aoMapIntensity at or below 1.

entries.title: iblIrradiance was removed from the shaders
entries.todo: Environment irradiance is added to `irradiance` now and RE_IndirectSpecular() lost its irradiance parameter: update the patched shader code.

entries.title: Float16BufferAttribute relies on Float16Array
entries.todo: Make sure the browsers you support have Float16Array (or load a polyfill).

entries.title: XREstimatedLight.lightProbe is a LightProbeGridWebGL without `sh`
entries.todo: Read the estimated spherical harmonics from the grid's texture instead of lightProbe.sh.
